name: Fixer (Liam)
description: Hands it the nagging admin tasks nobody gets round to, then works through them independently — digging into the details and only coming back when a decision or your authority is genuinely required. Built to run in isolation, so it suits self-contained errands rather than work needing other bots or ongoing collaboration.

official.title: Fixer by Liam
official.description: Take annoying loose-end problems you give it, investigate fully, and get them as close to resolved as possible before needing you. Isolated: talk only...
